decision.readout_hypothesis: Supported at the matched one-epoch budget: IoU, Precision, Recall and high-density Recall improve; final-weight health passes unchanged budgets.
decision.retain: Keep this independent checkpoint as the preferred current grid ANN diagnostic control; preserve previous ANN/SNN sources and runs.
decision.promotion: Not promoted to a final H2-pro replacement, low-MAC implementation or complete SNN.
decision.next_stage: Pause extended grid training. First audit direct layer conversion preserving frozen H2-pro causal features and MLP: exact ANN replay, per-layer mapping, Train-main activation ranges and complete cost accounting.
decision.reason: IoU remains 42.04 percentage points below the frozen teacher, dense Refiner MAC remains 412.58 G, and train_060 gains 724 false positives. One epoch cannot establish capacity or convergence.

limits: Single seed, one completed epoch; not a convergence/capacity or statistical-significance claim.
Train-main fits weights, fixed Train-dev threshold grid selects operating point. Validation/Test/HW-calibration not used.
Dense MAC count remains unchanged; continuous head is not an AC-only SNN or a hardware energy measurement.
Head positive-amplitude proxy is monitor-only; original limits and both-sign voltage penalty remain.
Different head recurrence implies its own true derivative; no learning-rate or gradient-scale compensation.
The previous 36.88% ANN-weight result was an untrained readout transplant, not the present fresh-seed trained model.
